query: How will we pre-register calibration rounds, sample size per round, stopping rules, and how will deviations be logged and justified?

response.query: How will we pre-register calibration rounds, sample size per round, stopping rules, and how will deviations be logged and justified?
response.answer: Pre-registration of calibration rounds, sample size, and stopping rules will be documented in the study protocol. Deviations will be logged in a dedicated log and justified with clear rationale. Compliance with ethical standards will be ensured.
